title: Sharing is CAIRing: Characterizing Principles and Assessing Properties of Universal Privacy Evaluation for Synthetic Tabular Data*
reasoning: The paper discusses the importance of privacy protection in data sharing, explicitly mentioning regulatory frameworks like GDPR and HIPAA, and framing privacy as a "natural right of people." The Interpretability principle of CAIR aims to ensure that privacy levels are understood by non-technical stakeholders, including regulators and natural persons, highlighting the ethical dimension of data privacy and data synthesis.
